name: ux-audit-agent
author: Andriy Yurchenko
madeBy: An AI agent following a fixed method. Not reviewed by a person.
disclaimer: This report was produced by an AI agent following a fixed method. It is good at what is on the screen: what happened at each step, where the friction sits, and what it measured. It cannot weigh a finding against your users, your numbers or the decisions behind the product, and it cannot tell which change deserves a sprint and which can wait. That call needs a person who has shipped and fixed products like this one.

cta.title: Not sure what to do first?
cta.body: Send this report to Andriy Yurchenko, the product designer behind this agent. He replies with a short note on what he would look at first, and says so if it needs more than a note.
cta.mailBody:
Hi Andriy,

Our ux-audit-agent report for {product} ({url}) is attached.

What we would like a second opinion on:

diagnosis.title: Product Diagnosis
diagnosis.text: A paid, deeper review: the findings checked against your users, data and plans, with a written recommendation. Scope is agreed before it starts.
diagnosis.mailBody:

card.text: For decisions the screen cannot settle{case}: a written recommendation from this report, your data and a call with your team.
